lines: 第一章：斯卡市的魔法光晕
夏末的风卷着梧桐叶掠过斯卡市的穹顶，空气里浮动着淡金色的微光——那是魔法能量在空气中自然流转的痕迹，也是幻灵国国都独有的印记。林澈背着洗得发白的帆布包站在北城门下，仰头望着这座悬浮在半空中的城市，喉结不自觉地滚动了一下。
城墙上镶嵌的“云纹水晶”正随着日光角度变换颜色，将流动的光网洒在每一条街道上。远处尖顶塔楼的顶端，偶尔有骑着光翼鸟的邮差掠过，魔法信笺在他们手中化作流光，飞向城市的各个角落。这就是斯卡市，幻灵国最璀璨的明珠，也是他此行的目的地——幻境学院的所在地。
帆布包里的入学通知书微微发烫，封面上烫金的校徽正散发着柔和的波动。林澈指尖轻轻拂过那枚由藤蔓、火焰与镜面交织而成的徽章，触感微凉，却像是有某种力量顺着皮肤钻进了四肢百骸。他来自幻灵国南部的边陲小镇，那里的魔法气息稀薄到几乎可以忽略不计，直到三个月前，这封凭空出现在窗台上的通知书，彻底改写了他的人生。
“请出示准入凭证。”城门守卫的声音打断了他的怔忡。那是个穿着银灰色铠甲的中年男人，肩甲上雕刻着幻灵国的国徽，眼神锐利如鹰，却在看到林澈手中通知书的瞬间柔和了几分。
“幻境学院的新生？”守卫接过通知书，指尖在封面上轻轻一点，校徽骤然亮起，投射出一道半透明的光幕，上面清晰地显示着林澈的名字、籍贯，以及一行小字——“特殊天赋持有者，空间感知力b级”。
守卫眼中闪过一丝讶异，随即抬手对着城门方向比了个手势。厚重的水晶门扉发出低沉的嗡鸣，在林澈面前裂开一道仅容一人通过的缝隙，门后涌来的魔法气息几乎让他打了个哆嗦。
“进去吧，新生。”守卫将通知书还给他，语气里带着不易察觉的善意，“沿着光纹路一直走，到第三个岔路口左转，会有学院的接引马车。”
林澈道了声谢，脚步有些发飘地走进城门。与城外的质朴不同，斯卡市的街道像是用流光织成的——石板路缝隙里嵌着会发光的苔藓，两侧的店铺招牌由悬浮的魔法字母组成，面包店门口的烤炉正自动翻转着缀满浆果的馅饼，香气混着甜腻的魔法波动扑面而来。
他下意识地抱紧了帆布包，手指却不受控制地伸向路边一株缠绕着荧光藤蔓的盆栽。指尖刚要触碰到叶片，藤蔓突然像有生命般蜷缩起来，顶端的花苞“噗”地绽开，吐出一个小小的光球，在他掌心转了两圈，化作一只透明的蝴蝶飞走了。
林澈吓了一跳，猛地收回手，却听见身后传来一声轻笑。
“第一次来斯卡市？”
他转过身，看见一个穿着淡绿色长裙的少女站在不远处，怀里抱着一个半人高的藤编篮子，篮子里装着几株叶片会轻轻颤动的植物。少女有着灵都国标志性的银灰色长发，发尾用一根编织的草绳松松系着，眼睛是剔透的翡翠色，正饶有兴致地看着他。
“嗯……”林澈有些窘迫地挠了挠头，“我是幻境学院的新生。”
“巧了，我也是。”少女笑着走近，伸出手，“我叫苏璃，来自灵都国。”
她的指尖微凉，带着草木的清香。林澈连忙握住她的手：“林澈，幻灵国南边来的。”
“灵都国以植物魔法闻名，看来你很擅长这个？”林澈看着她篮子里的植物，那些叶片似乎在苏璃说话时轻轻摇曳起来。
苏璃眨了眨眼，指尖在一株长着心形叶片的植物上轻轻一点，叶片立刻舒展开，露出中间藏着的几颗晶莹的露珠：“算是吧，家里是做草药生意的。不过比起战斗魔法，我更喜欢这些能让人舒服起来的小东西。”她说着，小心地摘下一片叶子递过来，“这个能提神，走长路的时候很有用。”
林澈接过叶片，果然闻到一股清冽的香气，刚才因为紧张而有些发沉的脑袋瞬间清醒了不少。他正想再说些什么，街角突然传来一阵刺耳的爆裂声，伴随着人群的惊呼。
两人同时转头望去，只见不远处的魔法集市方向，一团橙红色的火焰正冲天而起，灼热的气浪隔着几条街都能感受到。火焰中隐约有什么东西在扭动，发出尖锐的嘶鸣。
“是火焰蜥蜴！”苏璃脸色微变，“有人的契约兽失控了！”
话音未落，一道身影裹挟着热浪从人群中冲了出来。那是个身材高大的少年，穿着魔法国特有的黑色皮甲，裸露的小臂上纹着火焰形状的刺青。他手中正抓着一根燃烧着的锁链，锁链另一端捆着一只巴掌大小、通体燃烧着火焰的蜥蜴，只是此刻那蜥蜴的火焰已经变成了危险的暗红色，不断挣扎着想要挣脱。
“该死的，安静点！”少年低吼着，试图用魔力压制失控的契约兽，但那蜥蜴反而更加狂暴，一口咬在锁链上，发出金属熔化的滋滋声。
周围的行人纷纷后退，几个穿着学院制服的学生正试图上前帮忙，却被那高温逼得难以靠近。林澈注意到，少年的额头上布满了冷汗，握着锁链的手也在微微颤抖，显然已经快支撑不住了。

Chapter 1: The Magical Halo of Ska City
The late summer wind swept the sycamore leaves across the dome of Ska City, and a pale golden shimmer floated in the air - it was the trace of the natural flow of magical energy in the air, and it was also the unique imprint of the Phantom Kingdom. Lin Che stood under the North City Gate carrying a washed-white canvas bag, looking up at the city suspended in mid-air, her Adam's apple rolling unconsciously.
The "moiré crystals" inlaid on the city wall are changing colors according to the angle of sunlight, spreading a flowing network of light on every street. At the top of the spire tower in the distance, postmen riding light-winged birds occasionally passed by, and the magic letters turned into streamers of light in their hands and flew to every corner of the city. This is Ska City, the brightest pearl of the Phantom Kingdom, and the location of the destination of his trip - the Academy of Illusion.
The admission notice in the canvas bag is slightly hot, and the gilded school badge on the cover is exuding soft waves. Lin Che's fingertips gently brushed the badge, which was intertwined with vines, flames and mirrors. It felt slightly cool, but it seemed as if some kind of power had penetrated along the skin and into the limbs. He came from a border town in the southern part of the Phantom Kingdom, where the magical atmosphere was so thin that it was almost negligible. Until three months ago, this notice appeared on the window sill out of thin air, completely rewriting his life.
"Please show your admission voucher." The voice of the city gate guard interrupted his hesitation. It was a middle-aged man wearing silver-gray armor. The national emblem of the Phantom Kingdom was engraved on the shoulder armor. His eyes were as sharp as an eagle, but he softened a bit when he saw the notice in Lin Che's hand.
"A new student at Illusion Academy?" The guard took the notice and tapped the cover with his fingertips. The school emblem suddenly lit up, projecting a translucent light curtain, which clearly displayed Lin Che's name, place of origin, and a line of small words - "Special talent holder, spatial perception level B".
A trace of surprise flashed in the guard's eyes, and then he raised his hand and gestured towards the city gate. The thick crystal door made a low buzzing sound, and a gap opened in front of Lin Che, allowing only one person to pass through. The magical aura coming from behind the door almost made him shiver.
"Go in, freshman." The guard returned the notice to him, with an imperceptible kindness in his tone. "Go straight along the light pattern road and turn left at the third fork. There will be a carriage from the college to pick you up."
Lin Che thanked her and walked into the city gate with a little wave of steps. Different from the simplicity outside the city, the streets of Ska City seem to be woven with flowing light - there are luminous moss embedded in the gaps between the stone roads, the shop signs on both sides are composed of suspended magic letters, and the oven at the door of the bakery is automatically turning the pies studded with berries, and the aroma is mixed with sweet magic fluctuations.
He subconsciously hugged the canvas bag tightly, but his fingers uncontrollably reached towards a potted plant wrapped with fluorescent vines on the side of the road. Just as his fingertips were about to touch the leaves, the vine suddenly curled up as if alive, and the bud at the top burst open, spitting out a small ball of light, which spun twice in his palm and turned into a transparent butterfly and flew away.
Lin Che was startled and pulled back her hand suddenly, only to hear a chuckle coming from behind her.
"First time coming to Ska City?"
He turned around and saw a girl wearing a light green dress standing not far away, holding a half-person tall rattan basket in her arms. The basket contained several plants with gently trembling leaves. The girl had Lingdu Kingdom's signature long silver-gray hair, the tail of which was loosely tied with a braided straw rope. Her eyes were clear emerald color, and she was looking at him with interest.
"Hmm..." Lin Che scratched her head in embarrassment, "I am a freshman at Illusion Academy."
"What a coincidence, so am I." The girl approached with a smile and stretched out her hand, "My name is Su Li, from Lingdu Kingdom."
Her fingertips were slightly cool, carrying the fragrance of vegetation. Lin Che quickly held her hand: "Lin Che, from the south of Phantom Kingdom."
"Lingdu Kingdom is famous for its plant magic. It seems that you are very good at this?" Lin Che looked at the plants in her basket. The leaves seemed to sway gently when Su Li spoke.
Su Li blinked and tapped her fingertips lightly on a plant with heart-shaped leaves. The leaves immediately unfolded, revealing a few crystal dewdrops hidden in the middle: "Well, my family is in the herbal business. But compared to combat magic, I prefer these little things that can make people feel comfortable." She said, carefully picking off a leaf and handing it over, "This can refresh you and is very useful when walking on a long road."
Lin Che took the leaf and indeed smelled a refreshing aroma. Her head, which had been a little heavy due to nervousness, instantly sobered up a lot. Just as he was about to say something else, there was suddenly a harsh crackling sound from the street corner, accompanied by exclamations from the crowd.
The two of them turned to look at the same time, and saw a ball of orange-red flames rising into the sky in the direction of the Magic Market not far away. The scorching air waves could be felt across several streets. Something was vaguely twisting in the flames, making a sharp scream.
"It's the Flame Lizard!" Su Li's face changed slightly, "Someone's contracted beast is out of control!"
Before he finished speaking, a figure rushed out of the crowd with a wave of heat. He was a tall young man, wearing the magic country's unique black leather armor, with a flame-shaped tattoo on his exposed forearm. He was holding a burning chain in his hand, and tied to the other end of the chain was a palm-sized lizard with flames burning all over its body, but at this moment, the lizard's flames had turned into a dangerous dark red, and it was constantly struggling to break free.
"Damn it, be quiet!" the young man growled, trying to use magic to suppress the out-of-control contracted beast, but the lizard became even more violent and bit into the chain, making a sizzling sound of molten metal.
